text:
The Walt Disney World theme park that experienced the largest growth in attendance from 2022 to 2023 was **EPCOT**.

| Park | 2022 Attendance | 2023 Attendance | YoY Growth |
|------|-----------------|-----------------|------------|
| Magic Kingdom | 17,133 | 17,720 | **+3.4 %** |
| Disney’s Hollywood Studios | 10,900 | 10,300 | –5.5 % |
| Disney’s Animal Kingdom | 9,027 | 8,770 | –2.8 % |
| **EPCOT** | **10,000** | **11,980** | **+19.8 %** |
| Disneyland Park (Anaheim) | 16,881 | 17,250 | +2.2 % |

The data come from the 2023 TEA/AECOM “Global Attractions Attendance Report,” which lists Walt Disney World’s four theme parks in the Top 20 U.S. attendance rankings:

- Magic Kingdom: 3.4 % increase (17,720 in 2023 vs 17,133 in 2022)【pdf page 16】  
- EPCOT: **19.8 % increase** (11,980 in 2023 vs 10,000 in 2022)【pdf page 16】

Given that EPCOT’s attendance rose by 1,980 guests (or 19.8 %)—the highest percentage increase among the four Walt Disney World parks—the biggest growth was recorded at EPCOT.
